loginSubtitle: Log in to pick up your conversations.
signupSubtitle: Pick a username. It's how people find you.
legalNotice: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
usernameHint: 3–20 characters: letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
displayNameHint: Defaults to your username when empty
resetSent: If that email exists, a reset link was sent.
confirmEmailBody: We sent a 6-digit code to your email. Enter it to finish signing up.
codeSentBody: If this email can be used, we sent a 6-digit code to <addr>{email}</addr>.
codeHint: Paste or type the code from the email.
usernameChanged: Username changed. You can change it again on {date}.
usernameNextChange: You can change your username again on {date}.
deleteConfirmBody: @{username} will be anonymized and you will be signed out. Your messages stay visible to others. This cannot be undone.
usernameCooldownHint: Usernames can change once every 14 days.
avatarHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to {maxMb} MB.
avatarTooLarge: This photo is {sizeMb} MB. Choose one that is {maxMb} MB or smaller.
avatarUnsupportedType: This file type isn't supported. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
avatarEmpty: This file is empty. Choose another photo.
sessionsHint: Devices where you are signed in.
revokeConfirmBody: {device} will be signed out and must log in again.
revokeOthersBody: Every device except this one will be signed out and must log in again.
revokedOthers: Signed out {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}.
deleteAccountHint: Type your username to confirm. Messages stay for others; your profile is anonymized.
exportHint: Download a copy of your data.
exportUnavailable: Export is not available yet. No archive is generated.
forgotPasswordSubtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code to set a new password.
resetPasswordSubtitle: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
newPasswordHint: At least {min} characters, including a letter (a–z) and a number.
resetExpiredBody: The reset code or link has expired or was already used. Request a new one to continue.
passwordHint: Changing it signs you in again on this device.
signOutOthersOnChange: Sign out of all other devices
emailPending: Check both inboxes. Your email changes to <email></email> once you confirm from both addresses.

reasons.session_revoked: This session was revoked. Sign in again.

reasons.signed_out: You’re signed out. Sign in to continue.
